version.description: Wire format version of the completion bitfield. See PROGRESS_DOCUMENT_VERSION in lib/progress/slots.ts.

completed.description: Fixed-width completion bitfield, one bit per challenge slot. Fixed width is deliberate: a document that never changes size costs no storage on update, only processing.

credentialPublicKey.description: COSE public key of the learner's passkey. An assertion carries the credential id but not this key, so the server retrieves it from the deterministic progress document before verifying the signature. Written once and never changed.

recipientId.description: Identity the certificate was issued to. Recorded as well as transferred, so the original recipient stays provable after any later transfer.

curriculumVersion.description: schemaVersion of the curriculum manifest the learner completed, so a certificate stays interpretable after the syllabus changes.

completed.description: Completion bitfield snapshot at the moment of issuance.
